Senses.Explanation: Samantabhadra is a named figure whom Chan records deploy in several connected ways, not merely as an elephant-riding image from an outside biography. Masters pair him with Manjusri and contrast their functions: Huangbo Xiyun calls Manjusri real discernment and Samantabhadra adaptive discernment, while Nanyang Huizhong invokes both to frame the disputed claim that green bamboo is the body of reality. Other records speak of entering Samantabhadra’s reality-realm body, call delusive activity and dusty toil his sphere, or raise the case in which Puyan cannot find him even after searching the whole world. The figure therefore does work in Chan as a paired term, a named sphere of responsive activity, and the absent object of a public case.
